BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Logs are typically read through remote log viewers or log aggregation services.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Reading the log entry is enough once the data is logged.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Access to the logs requires a low-privileged account, such as an operator or support user.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No victim action is needed; the data is logged during normal operation.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Exposure stays within the logging system of the same application.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Passwords, tokens, environment variables or personal data are exposed in clear text.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Logging the data does not modify it.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Logging the data does not affect availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
